page.overview:
What is Edenian Sword?

Edenian Swords are the ancient weapons wielded only by soldiers of the Edenian Knights (also known as the Edenian Freedom Fighters). They are weapons forged of sacred Edenian steel and are awarded to warriors trained in Edenia's army. They are also blessed and rewarded by the Royal Family of Edenia for millennia to whoever is worthy of the knighthood, of becoming a loyal soldier and a faithful ally to fight for the Edenian Crown and for the people of Edenia. The Edenian Swords made their first appearance within the Konquest mode of Mortal Kombat: Deception.

Shujinko, while exploring the majestic civilization of Edenia, is found and asked by one of its citizens, a young man with a bald head who is longing to fight as an Edenian Freedom Fighter, to bring his sword to Queen Sindel and asking her to bless the blade. Queen Sindel consented and granted the blessing of the young man's sword. When his blessed sword returned back to him, the young man was finally ready to join the Freedom Fighters and fight in the name of Edenia.
